propositions: The outbound mapper receives assignee_resolver via attribute injection (getattr discovery with silent fallback) rather than explicit parameter, hiding dependencies from type checking and enabling silent degradation to non-authoritative resolution when injection fails

Four production sites and one test site use _assignee_resolver via attribute assignment and discovery: the core injection in outbound_field_diff.py, Cloud and DC getattr calls in resolve_assignee implementations, and DC constructor injection onto self.outbound with type: ignore[attr-defined]

DC's constructor-bound resolver and the per-jira_key core resolver have different lifecycles, with core overwriting constructor state; the explicit form must preserve this precedence while making the dependency visible and typechecked

The resolver parameter must be threaded through diff_canonical_fields (where resolve_assignee is called) from compute_update_fields (where the resolver is known), requiring an intermediate hop not currently parameterized

With resolver absent (the current default), resolution degrades to non-authoritative string matching silently; this behavior must become an explicit documented default parameter rather than an invisible injection failure outcome
